configurations.name: CHECAR FRONTEND
configurations.command: docker exec -it application_typescript_container bash -c "go run /workspace/build.go check"

configurations.name: COMPILAR FRONTEND PARA DESENVOLVIMENTO
configurations.command: docker exec -it application_esbuild_container bash -c "go run /workspace/build.go build"

configurations.name: COMPILAR FRONTEND PARA PRODUCAO
configurations.command: docker exec -it application_esbuild_container bash -c "go run /workspace/build.go compile"

configurations.name: EXECUTAR TAURI
configurations.command: docker exec application_tauri_container bash -c "pnpm tauri dev --config desktop/tauri.conf.json"
